# Flexera

> > Flexera provides comprehensive hybrid IT spend and risk management solutions including ITAM, SaaS management, FinOps, and security compliance across enterprise environments.

Flexera is a leading platform for managing IT assets, cloud costs, and software licenses across hybrid and multi-cloud infrastructures. The company offers integrated solutions through Flexera One, its unified platform for visibility and optimization of IT spending and compliance.

## Key Topics

- Flexera One
- ITAM (IT Asset Management)
- FinOps
- SaaS Management
- License Optimization
- Cloud Cost Management
- CMDB Data Quality
- Software Asset Management
- Vendor License Management
- IT Security & Compliance
- Cost Optimization
- Multi-cloud
- Spend Visibility
- ESG & Sustainability
- AI-Powered Solutions

## Core Platform

- [Flexera Homepage](https://www.flexera.com): Flexera homepage showcasing ITAM, SaaS, FinOps solutions for hybrid IT spend and risk management
- [AI-Powered Transformation Solutions](https://www.flexera.com/solutions/ai-powered-transformation): AI-driven ITAM, FinOps, and SaaS management solutions leveraging ChatGPT and machine learning

## License & Software Management

- [Software Audits and License Renewal Solutions](https://www.flexera.com/solutions/software-renewals-audits): Comprehensive software audits and license renewal solutions for compliance and risk mitigation
- [Strategic Software License Management & Cost Optimization](https://www.flexera.com/solutions/software-usage-costs): Software license management and cost optimization reducing spending by up to 30%
- [IT Inventory & Asset Discovery Solutions](https://www.flexera.com/solutions/it-inventory): Complete IT asset discovery and inventory visibility across hybrid environments
- [IT Asset Lifecycle Management Solutions](https://www.flexera.com/solutions/it-asset-lifecycle): Comprehensive IT asset lifecycle management with end-of-life and end-of-support prevention

## SaaS & Cloud Cost Management

- [SaaS Spend Management Solutions](https://www.flexera.com/solutions/saas-spend): SaaS cost visibility and optimization with Flexera One SaaS Management platform
- [Manage Your Cloud Costs with Flexera](https://www.flexera.com/solutions/cloud-cost): FinOps multi-cloud and hybrid cloud cost optimization and governance platform

## IT Operations & Data Quality

- [Improve CMDB Data Quality & Asset Management](https://www.flexera.com/solutions/cmdb-data-quality): CMDB data quality improvement and IT asset management with data normalization and validation
- [IT Security & Regulatory Risk Management Solutions](https://www.flexera.com/solutions/it-security-regulatory-risk): Security and compliance management with SBOM generation and vulnerability tracking
